assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only yuru-camp:inuyama-aoi@manga#reviewed-synthesis-document04-aoi, the active_provisional Document04 shared synthesis of Ōgaki Chiaki, Inuyama Aoi and Saitō Ena (Japanese main manga V01-V19) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis. Claims about Aoi (Inuyama Aoi) are drawn from §3 and from the passages of §§1-2 and 4-7 that name her; §§2 and 4 are not otherwise used. The project's corpus map and character reconstruction specification were read for method, authority and scope only; the specification's statement that no subject has a readiness determination is an input, not a conclusion. The volume readings, the five longitudinal ledgers, Documents02-03, 05-06, 10 and 12, the checkpoints and the Japanese source images are not curated evidence on this subject, and nothing is borrowed from them. No anime, anthology or post-V19 material is included, and the evaluator inspected no primary source.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Japanese main manga V01-V19 as read through the six accepted checkpoints and the V19 transaction, with the dated post-V19 complements placed in their story epochs. States are split at the located transitions: the thin, partly extracted early baseline; the V04 Christmas meal; the V06 shared cold failure; the V13 gifted bicycle, first extended ride, puncture and pickup; the V14 private repair doubt; the V15 explicit beginner status with Mei (Nakatsugawa Mei); and V19 continued practice around supermarket shifts. V16-V18 give her no main-story cycling, which is read as neither plateau nor improvement. The V19 Golden Week scenes have parallel or retrospective framing, and bonus-strip (Heya) scenes are kept as their own mode. No default state is set, and no state after V19 is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Document04 gives bounded interpretations of Aoi (Inuyama Aoi), not a motive model: an ability is attached to a task and its conditions rather than to a universal rank (§3.4); her cycling is co-learning with unequal local experience (§3.4); her play is relationship- and mode-specific (§3.3); and she is a person who contributes, plays, pursues a new activity and manages limits (§3.6). Each rejects a named rival, the stable reassuring helper and the expert who changes hobby domains (§3.6). C is rejected: the discovery row claims no psychology dimension; the document calls itself "a character reference through a current corpus boundary, not a finished-series account or a behavioral model" (opening); it gives no reason why she takes up cycling, teases, or stops; and it says the evidence supports separate subject accounts "more strongly than invariant traits or predictions" (§6). E would understate rival-tested interpretations that constrain extrapolation by task and condition.

The document locates one clear capacity change and keeps its knowledge boundaries: the V13 gifted bicycle, practice, extended ride, puncture and pickup (E13-04); the V14 private recall of her father's puncture instruction, her tube and valve doubts, and her choice to refrain and arrange the teacher's truck (E14-01); the V15 explicit beginner status and near-peer pacing with Mei (Nakatsugawa Mei) (E15-01/02); no main-story cycling in V16-V18, which it reads as neither plateau nor improvement; and V19 commuting and repeated riding around supermarket shifts, soreness and negotiated rest (E19-15) (§§3.4-3.5). It forbids backcasting the bicycle into her V03 state (§3.1). B is rejected: the document says her early state is "comparatively thin" and partly extracted (E03-03/CS06, §3.1); the cooking lane is essentially the V04 meal plus the V17 relayed curry idea; the broad V15 execution arc stays extracted (E15-03); and outside cycling no state change with conditions is given. D would understate a located capacity arc with explicit knowledge and transfer limits.

The document gives about nine source-verified lines from Aoi (Inuyama Aoi), each with a recipient and situation (§§3.2-3.6): the peer request 炒めといてくれへん？ to Chiaki (Ōgaki Chiaki); おそまつさま in reply to Rin's (Shima Rin's) thanks; the flashback bridge ちゅー訳や; 忘れとった when recognizing the overlooked altitude and weather; the greeting おはよーさん; the comic パワハラはだめよ to Chiaki; the admission やっぱバレてもうたか to Nadeshiko (Kagamihara Nadeshiko); and 初心者やからな and 行けるとこまで頑張ろか to Mei (Nakatsugawa Mei) (JV11/13/18/23/56/67/74-76). It says this supports "a recurrent regional voice at a bounded level" but is "not an exhaustive dialect distribution or permission to generate exaggerated generic Kansai", and it removes the grandmother's special-day maxim from her voice (ER-006). B is rejected: there is no distributional rule, no self-reference sample and no line to an adult or teacher. D would understate attested regional forms across peer, junior, comic and practical settings with recipients attached.

Ordinary activity is located in two lanes with other hands named: the V04 Christmas meal she directs, delegating the onion to Chiaki (Ōgaki Chiaki), remaking it as tomato, announcing a further course and stopping when the fuel runs out, with each person's contribution to the shortage kept separate (E04-03-06, §§3.1-3.2); the V17 oden-to-curry idea relayed in her absence (E17-12); and cycling practice from V13 to V19, including the pickup, the beginner pace, commuting and riding around supermarket shifts, soreness and rest (§§3.4-3.5). Her request to include her sister Akari (Inuyama Akari) and the bedding discussion add a family errand (E08-02). B is rejected: the document says she is more precisely recoverable "as a cook, a sister making a travel request, a participant in failure and a later beginner than across every ordinary family, work or romantic context" (§3.1); her work appears only as a schedule constraint; and school life is not covered. D would understate attributed, located episodes that include her limits.

The document separates Aoi's (Inuyama Aoi's) conduct by recipient: delegation, a shared false etymology and comic boundary-setting with Chiaki (Ōgaki Chiaki), who also gives her a brake-holding aid and quiet company (E04-03, E18-20, E12-03, E13-04); thanks received from Rin (Shima Rin); a fabricated conspiracy aimed at Nadeshiko (Kagamihara Nadeshiko), and being the believing recipient of Nadeshiko's later hoax (E18-19, E19-19); beginner self-positioning, a provisional goal and negotiated rest with Mei (Nakatsugawa Mei), whose own choices stay hers (E15-01/02, E19-15/17); and a sister request to Toba, the teacher, and family occasions with her father and grandmother kept as distinct sources (E08-02, E14-01, E04-05). It records that Mei does not receive her private repair reasoning (§3.4). B is rejected: most dyads are sampled once; her relation to Ena (Saitō Ena) is barely covered; the document assigns the wider longitudinal dyads to the relationship synthesis, which is not evidence here (§7); and no account says how she adjusts to an unsampled relation. D would understate directed, knowledge-aware conduct across at least five relations.

One private-thought sequence is located: in V14 the reader receives her recalled puncture instruction and her doubt about tube and valve compatibility as thought, and the document keeps that reasoning from Mei (Nakatsugawa Mei) (E14-01, §3.4). Otherwise her states are shown outwardly (pleasure in the ride, soreness, receiving praise). C is rejected: no interpretation of her inner life is offered, and the row claims no psychology dimension. E would understate a located private state that sets a knowledge boundary a model must respect.

Only one located act comes near friction: her comic パワハラはだめよ to Chiaki (Ōgaki Chiaki) over an imagined coercion of juniors, which the document reads as comic boundary-setting toward a fantasy, not an enacted dispute (E12-03, §3.3). Her V19 offer to stop or rest when conditions change is a pace negotiation with Mei (Nakatsugawa Mei), not conflict (§3.5). D is rejected: no interpersonal friction, refusal or repair involving her is located. NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the one located boundary act.

The discovery row claims no ethics dimension, and the document locates no ethical deliberation by Aoi (Inuyama Aoi). Her comic objection to imagined coercion and her admitted fabrication are play, graded under HUMOR_PLAY. Nothing is established here, so no grade is given; this is not a finding about her moral reasoning.

The document separates modes of play with recipients (§3.3): comic boundary-setting toward Chiaki's (Ōgaki Chiaki's) imagined junior labor (E12-03); a fabricated mutual-finance conspiracy that frightens Nadeshiko (Kagamihara Nadeshiko), with the admission やっぱバレてもうたか when detected (E18-19); a collaborative false etymology with Chiaki that Ena (Saitō Ena) and Rin (Shima Rin) recognize while Nadeshiko does not (E18-20); and the contrary V19 case where she believes Nadeshiko's invented mushroom story (E19-19). It warns that regional speech guarantees neither truth nor joking, and that her other explanations keep their own support. B is rejected: the V18 instances are bonus-strip (Heya) scenes, the early teasing remains a lead without isolated primary scope (§3.1), and the document does not say when she plays rather than stays earnest. D would understate distinct, located modes with recipients, an admission form and a contrary case.

The evidence is §3 of one active_provisional shared synthesis (about 14 KB of a 56 KB document covering three subjects), with her appearances in §§2 and 4-7, over the Japanese main manga V01-V19, with literal-image or EPUB-spine locators and P or A status. C is rejected: the document's own coverage table says her early baseline and detailed personal birthday reception "remain thinner" (§6); early group participation (E03-03/CS06) and the broad V15 execution arc (E15-03) stay ANALYSIS_EXTRACTED; the wider dyads belong to a relationship synthesis that is not on the row (§7); V19 is not the manga's ending; and the anime and anthologies are outside the boundary. E would understate primary-verified, located coverage across V04-V19.

The document records affirmative limits on Aoi (Inuyama Aoi): the expert-cyclist father story is retracted as an April Fool joke and gives no pedigree (E14-01); she refrains from an uncertain repair and no completed repair is shown (E14-01); she names herself a recent beginner (初心者やからな, E15-01); the V19 Motosuko goal is replaced by a nearer photograph and not completed (E19-14/15); the special-day maxim is her grandmother's voice, not hers (ER-006); the announced cheese pasta is an intention, not a shown dish; the V17 curry pot is not hers (E17-12); the V13 imagined Nadeshiko cycling is a separate mode (CR06); Akari is Inuyama Akari and the Sakura entrustment reference stays withdrawn (ER-002); she is fooled by Nadeshiko's (Kagamihara Nadeshiko's) hoax (E19-19); and Mei (Nakatsugawa Mei) does not receive her private reasoning. A is rejected: limits are episode-located, not a census, and conflict and ethics remain gaps rather than negative findings. C would understate a record that repeatedly marks what she did not do, know or own.

Claims carry volume, literal raw-image or EPUB-spine locators and P or A status, with story epochs kept apart from later admission, explicit leakage guards (the V13 bicycle cannot explain V03 knowledge, §3.1), the V16-V18 absence read as neither plateau nor improvement, and the V19 Golden Week scenes flagged as parallel or retrospective in framing (§3.5). A is rejected: the early state and the broad V15 arc are ANALYSIS_EXTRACTED, and the V18 play scenes are bonus strips. C would understate a locator-bound account with explicit controls on what each state knows.

conditions: Illustrative Japanese only, never quotation, in short turns whose purpose and recipient are fixed before wording: a peer task request, a reply to thanks, a greeting, a beginner's self-positioning or provisional proposal to a junior, an admission that a joke was detected.
Regional forms follow the attested samples (for example へん, や, とった, もうた, ろか) at a bounded level; no exaggerated generic Kansai and no frequency claim.
Recipients are Chiaki (Ōgaki Chiaki), Rin (Shima Rin), Nadeshiko (Kagamihara Nadeshiko) and Mei (Nakatsugawa Mei) in their sampled roles; no attested register for adults, teachers or strangers.
The grandmother's special-day maxim is not her voice; no self-reference rule, sustained conflict, serious distress or formal setting.
scenario_readiness.note: Generated lines are noncanonical by nature. For short recipient-conditioned turns in sampled relations the attested regional forms constrain the output; outside them they do not.

conditions: A bounded novel meal, ride or outing in one selected state, with a sampled companion and stated material conditions (fuel, equipment, transport, schedules, fatigue).

The response is given as a range: directing a dish while delegating tasks; proposing effort toward a provisional goal and offering rest or stopping when conditions change; refraining from an uncertain repair and arranging help; teasing with a fabrication and admitting it when detected, or being the one fooled.
Other people's contributions (driving, pickup, fuel, cooking steps, consent) stay theirs, and her private reasoning is not shared unless shown.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One explicitly selected state, and nothing later: before V13 (cooking, play and the V06 shared failure; no cycling capacity), V13-V15 (gifted bicycle, first rides, puncture, private repair doubts, explicit beginner with Mei (Nakatsugawa Mei)), or V19 (continued practice around supermarket shifts, soreness and negotiated rest). The early state is thin and partly extracted. V19 is not the manga's ending.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Chiaki (Ōgaki Chiaki), Nadeshiko (Kagamihara Nadeshiko), Rin (Shima Rin) and Mei in their sampled roles; Toba, the teacher, and her sister Akari (Inuyama Akari) only within the sampled request and pickup. Ena (Saitō Ena), other family members and strangers are unsampled; a comparable peer is a separate, lower-confidence transfer.
setting_constraints: Camping meals, road cycling, school-friend outings and household errands in a realistic contemporary Japanese setting with stated money, fuel, equipment, transport, work schedules and fatigue
Outputs are ranges with alternatives; the evidence does not say when she plays rather than stays earnest, or when she presses on rather than stops
No technical repair competence, expert cycling, sustained conflict, romance, ethical dilemma, workplace exchange or formal setting, and no setting or technology absent from the V01-V19 manga

scenario_readiness.note: Supported only as a range in cooking, cycling and play; the document is explicitly not a behavioral model and gives no rule for what decides between alternatives.

conditions: Sampled ordinary classes only: campsite cooking with delegation and received thanks, road-cycling practice and pace negotiation, a family errand request, group outings with shared failure, and bonus-strip play.
Abilities stay attached to the task and conditions: a competent cook can still run out of fuel, and a more experienced rider is still a beginner who seeks pickup.
Money, fuel, transport, work schedules and fatigue stay in force; she can be wrong, sore or fooled.
School life, work exchanges and family life beyond the sampled occasions are outside these conditions.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary activity is the substance of the evidence, but it is located in the cooking and cycling lanes; other ordinary contexts are unsupported.
The document locates no ethical deliberation by her, and the row claims no ethics dimension. This limits use; it is not a finding that she lacks moral reasoning.
The document states that no romance or yuri promotion is supplied (§6), and no romantic conduct by her is located. This limits use; friendship is covered under MUNDANE_SOCIAL and CROSS_SCENARIO.
Her supermarket shifts appear only as a constraint on V19 riding (§3.5), and no workplace exchange is located. Cooking and cycling are covered under MUNDANE_SOCIAL.

known_limits.statement: The evidence is an active_provisional synthesis through the Japanese main manga V19, the end of the authorized reading run and not the manga's ending. No state after V19 is established, and the anime and anthologies are excluded.

Document04 calls itself a character reference, not a behavioral model, and says its evidence supports separate subject accounts with named domains and temporal changes more strongly than invariant traits or predictions.

Her early state is comparatively thin: early group participation (E03-03/CS06) is ANALYSIS_EXTRACTED, and early teasing and personal birthday reception remain leads without isolated primary scope. Later cycling cannot fill that gap.
Besides the early baseline, the broad V15 execution arc (E15-03) keeps ANALYSIS_EXTRACTED status and supports the account at analytical strength only.

She is an explicit recent beginner: the expert-father pedigree is retracted as an April Fool joke, she refrains from an uncertain repair and arranges pickup, and the V19 lake goal is not completed. Seniority and help do not make her an expert or a repairer.
The special-day sukiyaki maxim is her grandmother's flashback speech transmitted by Aoi (Inuyama Aoi) (ER-006). Only her bridge ちゅー訳や is her own line in that passage.
Her V14 repair doubts and recalled instruction are thought the reader receives; Mei (Nakatsugawa Mei) is not shown receiving them, so no teaching of those limits is established.
The document assigns the wider longitudinal dyads to the relationship synthesis and comparative voice and practice to other specialists; none of those documents is evidence for this subject.
Some apparent stable differences may reflect which character a scene assigns a practical or comic task, and the selected original checks are not a balanced frequency sample of nineteen volumes.
Nothing in the evidence says why she takes up cycling, when she chooses play over earnestness, or when she presses on rather than stops.
Sustained interpersonal conflict and ethical deliberation involving her are not covered.
